name: Connect MSSQL v3 Dev Container
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl unzip && curl -sSL https://github.com/microsoft/go-sqlcmd/releases/latest/download/sqlcmd-linux-amd64.zip -o sqlcmd.zip && unzip sqlcmd.zip sqlcmd.exe && sudo mv sqlcmd.exe /usr/local/bin/sqlcmd && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sqlcmd && rm sqlcmd.zip && npm install && npm run build

postAttachCommand.1_createDatabase: sqlcmd -S db -U sa -P YourStrong(!)Password123 -d master -Q "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.databases WHERE name = 'TestSessionDB') CREATE DATABASE TestSessionDB; ELSE PRINT 'Database TestSessionDB already exists.';"
postAttachCommand.2_createSessionsTable: sqlcmd -S db -U sa -P YourStrong(!)Password123 -d TestSessionDB -Q "IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.sessions', 'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.sessions (sid nvarchar(255) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, session nvarchar(max) NOT NULL, expires datetime NOT NULL); ELSE PRINT 'Table dbo.sessions already exists.';"
